text:
anya: onboarding intake for cinnabar-6b (open-weight) — found strange generation drift after q4_0 quant + rotary mix when context > 2k. can we triage?
samir: thanks, anya. quick notes: baseline fp16 looks fine. q4_0 quant shows ~1.8% BLEU drop on our long-context evals; short contexts ok.
leo: curious if this is RoPE scaling mismatch or KV eviction ordering. did you test with rotary scaling disabled?
anya: not yet. re-ran with runtime flag --kv-max-len=4096 and still saw drift. adding sample logs below: 
```
[2026-03-18T14:12:03Z] model=cinnabar-6b quant=q4_0 runtime=prod-rt1 seq=3072 prompt_len=512
[INFO] generation_step=128 token=... probability_drop=0.0025 mean_logprob=-3.12
[WARN] kv_cache_evicted=false rotary_scale=1.0
```
zara: that log shows rotary_scale=1.0 which might be the model's embed-time scale (expected 0.5 for this checkpoint). if runtime assumes a different RoPE base, the phase will drift across positions.
samir: another hint: when we run the same quantized weights in local bench harness (cpu/vulkan) with explicit rotary base=0.5 the outputs match fp16. so it's likely a runtime/metadata mismatch.
leo: are model config fields normalized? some checkpoints use 'rope_base' vs 'rotary_base' naming. runtime loader might default.
anya: model card has: "rotary_scale": 0.5 and config key is rope_base. checkpoint loader printed none -> possible mapping bug in our importer.
ops-bot: deploy pipeline note — can we avoid flipping production version until triage complete? current traffic is small but flagging. :warning:
samir: planned next steps: (1) reproduce in minimal harness with seq=4096 using q4_0 and q5_0; (2) run with rotary override to confirm; (3) run kv-eviction probe: send long prefix then many short requests to see tail coherence; (4) check importer mapping for rope_base|rotary_base aliasing.
leo: I can take step 1+2 today, will push a tiny test harness in repo: eng-ml/cinnabar-smoke. sample command: 
```
PYTHONPATH=./harness python tests/rotary_probe.py --model=weights/cinnabar-6b.q4_0 --seq=4096 --rotary-base=0.5
```
zara: I'll audit the importer mapping and add unit test for both config keys. also will grep for other models with rope_base vs rotary_base to catch similar.
anya: thanks — if we confirm it's a metadata mismatch we should add a validation check during model ingest: assert rotary_scale present or require explicit override. also add quick perf sanity (BLEU/regression) for long-context smoke.
samir: agreed. if q5_0 fixes some artifacts we should record cost/latency impact. put experimental results as a short table in PR description.
leo: starting now, I'll post short results here when I have them.
anya: great. tagging @zara @samir — feel free to DM if you need infra. :thumbsup:
ops-bot: note — created incident draft 'cinnabar-rotary-kv-smoke-197840' for tracking, status=investigating.
